body.name: Inverted complete-law confidence set
body.construction:
Let \(c_\alpha\) calibrate the simultaneous complete-family spectral event
\[
\inf_{\theta\in\mathcal M_{n,k,m}}
\Pr_\theta\{D_H(\mathbb P_\theta,\widehat{\mathbb P}_L)\le c_\alpha\rho_N\}
\ge1-\alpha-o(1),
\]
including the deterministic Fourier bias. Define
\[
\mathcal C_N(\alpha)=\left\{[h_\vartheta]:
\vartheta\in\mathcal M_{n,k,m}(c_0,C_0,K,a_0,J,\Delta_0),\ 
D_H(\vartheta,\widehat\theta_N)\le2c_\alpha\rho_N+2\delta_N\right\}.
\]
The factor two is the triangle-inequality cost of comparing the true model and the minimum-distance fit through the estimated environment-law family.
